name: Combinatorics
description: Basic counting techniques; The Pigeonhole Principle; the Principle of Inclusion–Exclusion; recurrence relations and generating functions; Catalan Numbers, and its; Difference Sequences and Stirling Numbers; Lattice Paths and Schroder Numbers; Systems of Distinct Representatives; Stable Marriages; Hall’s Theorem; Burnside's lemma and Pólya enumeration theorem; Latin squares; combinatorial designs and Steiner Triple Systems; Ramsey theory; Mobius Inversion; Extremal set theory.
